title: An agent buys one API call: actors and protocol boundaries
caption: Discovery runs through the x402 Bazaar or ERC-8004 registries; payment is x402 between client, seller, facilitator and token contract; feedback is ERC-8004, with the proof of payment in an off-chain file and only value, decimals, tags and the revoked flag in registry storage. Numbers follow the scenario flow.
alt: Flowchart. The client agent finds the seller either through an x402 Bazaar discovery listing or by reading the ERC-8004 Identity Registry, whose agentURI points to a registration file with services and x402Support. The client requests the resource from the seller's resource server, gets a 402, and retries with a signed payment. The resource server asks the x402 facilitator to verify and settle; the facilitator pays the gas and calls transferWithAuthorization on the token contract, which emits Transfer and AuthorizationUsed. The client then publishes a feedback file carrying proofOfPayment to off-chain storage and calls giveFeedback on the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry with the file URI and hash; the registry stores value, decimals, tags and the revoked flag. An indexer or later buyer reads the NewFeedback event, fetches the file and confirms the transfer on chain.

sourceOfTruth.label: ERC-8004 specification (Draft, 2026-01-25) and the x402 V2 specification
